The '''J0-1Y''' was a type of [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]-like [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] manufactured by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron J0-1Y first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[2014]] [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration; it is available for purchase in the Cartel Market, and is a spoof of Santa's sleigh similar to the [[2013]] vehicle [[Sleigh I]].
